purpose: Provide the canonical mutable status ledger for evidence-production work in the current-slice catalog review.
Track each evidence work item, expected evidence type, producer, validator, dependencies, blockers, submissions, validation state, fingerprints, staleness, and completion eligibility.
Allow Chronicle delivery infrastructure to calculate evidence readiness and downstream task, action, review, and promotion state deterministically.
Prevent planned, submitted, rejected, or stale evidence from being treated as validated evidence.

consistencyRules.requirement: every evidence-plan work item has exactly one status record
required evidence types match the evidence plan
declared and missing dependencies reconcile with work-item statuses
every blocked work item has an issue, blocker, or missing dependency
every complete work item has all required accepted and current evidence
statusSummary counts reconcile with work-item and evidence records
planned, present, submitted, rejected, or stale evidence never counts as validated
